session.question: What is SG in this review?
session.answer:
In this review, SG refers to the smart grid. The context repeatedly defines SG as “smart grid” in the setting of sustainable energy technology, smart grid research progress, and smart grid authentication protocols. (ahsan2023datadrivennextgenerationsmart chunk 1, geng2023researchprogressanalysis chunk 1, tanveer2023lacpsglightweightauthentication chunk 1)

More specifically, the review uses SG to denote the smart grid as an energy system framework for efficient, reliable, and sustainable power delivery. This is consistent across the cited sources, including a review of next-generation smart grid technologies and a bibliometric analysis of sustainable smart grid research. (ahsan2023datadrivennextgenerationsmart chunk 1, geng2023researchprogressanalysis chunk 1)
